stories.headline: SK Hynix posts record Q3, says DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029, plans ~100T won in returns

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix reported Q3 2026 revenue of 104.6155 trillion won and operating profit of 83.3338 trillion won (80% operating margin); quarterly sales topped 100 trillion won for the first time.
key_facts.excerpt: Reports revenues of 104.6155 trillion won, operating profit of 83.3338 trillion won, net profit of 39.7756 trillion won; Quarterly sales surpass 100 trillion won for the first time

key_facts.fact: Revenue rose 328% and operating profit 632% year on year; versus Q2, revenue rose 32% and operating profit 38%.
SK Hynix has signed long-term agreements (LTAs) with 14 major customers, including large cloud providers, covering more than 50% of its 2027-2028 production capacity; standard terms are five years.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has currently signed LTAs with 14 major customers, including leading global cloud service providers (CSPs)... contract terms, which are typically five years. The LTA volume secured to date corresponds to more than 50% of total production capacity for 2027 and 2028.

key_facts.fact: The company said its DRAM and HBM volumes through 2029 are effectively sold out; LTA customers rose from 10 the previous quarter to 14.
key_facts.excerpt: "our DRAM and HBM volumes for the next three years through 2029 are effectively sold out"... 14 major customers, including leading cloud service providers, up from 10 in the previous quarter.

key_facts.fact: HBM sales chief Kim Ki-tae said customers are requesting more than twice the volume SK Hynix can supply.
key_facts.excerpt: "Customers are requesting more than twice the volume we can supply," said Kim Ki-tae, head of HBM sales and marketing at SK hynix.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix plans about 100 trillion won in 2026 shareholder returns: at least 30 trillion won in dividends and at least 60 trillion won in buybacks and cancellations, including the 40 trillion won buyback completed last week.
key_facts.excerpt: shareholder returns totaling approximately 100 trillion won, comprising cash dividends of 30 trillion won or more and share repurchases and cancellations of 60 trillion won or more in total, including the 40 trillion won announced in August.

key_facts.fact: The board approved a Q3 dividend of 20,000 won per share (14 trillion won), half of it a special dividend from Kioxia investment gains, plus a new 20 trillion won buyback.
key_facts.excerpt: It also approved a third-quarter dividend of 20,000 won per share, split equally between an earnings-based dividend and a special payout tied to gains from its investment in Japanese NAND flash memory maker Kioxia.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix expects HBM4 to surpass HBM3E in shipments and revenue in Q4 and will ramp its M15X fab to maximum capacity by year-end.
key_facts.excerpt: the company will ramp up M15X to maximum capacity by the end of the year to increase HBM4 production. Accordingly, the company expects HBM4 to surpass HBM3E in both shipment volume and revenue in the fourth quarter

stories.headline: Oracle will offer Google TPUs on its cloud, a first; OpenAI reportedly plans to buy TPUs too

key_facts.fact: Oracle and Google announced on Oct. 27 at Oracle AI World that Google TPUs will be available on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, the first hyperscale cloud outside Google to offer them.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle and Google today announced that Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) will be available through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), marking the first time Google TPUs will be offered on a hyperscale cloud platform outside Google.

key_facts.fact: TPUs on OCI will be available in calendar 2027, ramping over several years; Oracle will provide power, cooling and networking.
key_facts.excerpt: Google TPUs on OCI will be available in calendar year 2027, ramping over a multi-year period to meet customer needs.

key_facts.fact: OCI SVP Karan Batta called it a multi-year, multi-gigawatt partnership and said Oracle will have each new TPU on day one.
key_facts.excerpt: it would be a "multi-year, multi-gigawatt partnership with Google..." ... "when Google launches a new TPU, we will have it on day one."

key_facts.fact: Oracle will also run OpenAI's Jalapeño chip and Cerebras hardware on OCI; Cerebras called its deal material but did not disclose scale, and its stock rose about 8%.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip and Cerebras will also run on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The Cerebras deal is material, but the AI chipmaker won't be disclosing the scale because it's in a quiet period... Cerebras stock climbed about 8%

key_facts.fact: Oracle and Nvidia said OCI will expand to multi-gigawatt scale with Vera Rubin servers; Huang has said Vera Rubin can generate up to $40 billion in revenue per gigawatt for Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle and Nvidia said the cloud firm will expand to "multi-gigawatt scale" with Nvidia's newest generation of "Vera Rubin" AI servers... Vera Rubin systems can generate up to $40 billion in revenue per gigawatt for the chipmaker.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reported on Oct. 27, citing a person familiar with the matter; financial terms were not disclosed and OpenAI declined to comment.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reported on Tuesday, citing a person familiar with the matter... The report did not disclose financial terms... OpenAI declined to comment.

key_facts.fact: An OpenAI job listing seeks an engineer to "lead the optimization" of its frontier models on TPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: We're looking for an engineer to lead the optimization of OpenAI's state-of-the-art frontier models on TPUs.

stories.headline: Onsemi in talks to buy AI chip power startup Ferric for about $1 billion

key_facts.fact: Onsemi has been discussing an acquisition of 16-year-old chip startup Ferric for close to $1 billion, The Information reported on Oct. 27, citing people familiar with the matter.
key_facts.excerpt: Semiconductor component maker Onsemi has been discussing an acquisition of 16-year-old chip startup Ferric for close to $1 billion, say people familiar with the matter

key_facts.fact: The deal structure is unclear and could include payments tied to performance targets; it could be finalized in the coming days.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal may include performance-based payments to Ferric as part of the agreement. The transaction could be finalized in the coming days

key_facts.fact: Ferric, based in New York and founded in 2010, makes integrated voltage regulators that deliver power directly to chips under or inside AI processors.
key_facts.excerpt: New York-based Ferric, founded in 2010, makes integrated voltage regulators that funnel power directly to small chips underneath or inside AI processors.

key_facts.fact: Ferric last raised a $32.1 million Series C in December 2024 and has raised about $41.8 million in total.
key_facts.excerpt: Across several funding rounds, the company raised approximately $41.8 million in total. That includes a $32.1 million Series C round in December 2024.

key_facts.fact: The talks follow rival Analog Devices' May agreement to buy AI power-chip startup Empower Semiconductor for $1.5 billion; Onsemi agreed this month to buy Synaptics for $5.7 billion in cash.
key_facts.excerpt: Rival Analog Devices agreed in May to buy Empower Semiconductor... for $1.5 billion... In October, it agreed to buy listed company Synaptics for $5.7 billion in cash.

stories.headline: Malaysia seizes $12 million in AI chip servers at KLIA, fifth case tied to one smuggling ring

key_facts.fact: Malaysian customs said on Oct. 28 it seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) of advanced AI chips this month at Kuala Lumpur International Airport.
key_facts.excerpt: Malaysian customs said on Wednesday (Oct 28) that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit (US$12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month

key_facts.fact: Officers found 30 server units with advanced AI chips on Oct. 15 in the airport's free trade zone; they were declared as electronic components and bound for re-export to another Asian country.
key_facts.excerpt: On Oct 15, authorities found 30 server units containing advanced AI chips... "The servers were falsely declared as electronic components ... and shipped through Malaysia to ensure there would be no restrictions"

key_facts.fact: It is the fifth case this year linked to the same suspected syndicate, with total seizures above 100 million ringgit; no arrests have been made.
key_facts.excerpt: the seizure was the fifth case involving the same syndicate recorded by Customs this year, with the total value of seizures across all five cases exceeding RM100 million... no arrests had been made so far.

key_facts.fact: Malaysia's directive requires a permit for chips with Total Processing Performance of 4,800 or more; officials withheld the chips' brands, origin and destination.
key_facts.excerpt: chips with a Total Processing Performance (TPP) value of 4,800 or higher, or 1,600 or higher when combined with a Performance Density of 3.2 or higher, require a permit... the brands, countries of origin and destinations of the chips could not be disclosed

key_facts.fact: Malaysia imposed export controls on US-origin advanced AI chips last year under US pressure to stem their flow into China.
key_facts.excerpt: Malaysia imposed export controls last year on the movement of advanced AI chips of US origin, following pressure from the United States to stem their flow into China

key_facts.fact: Under the Strategic Trade Act 2010, corporations face fines of up to 20 million ringgit; individuals face up to 10 million ringgit and 10 years in prison.
key_facts.excerpt: a fine of up to RM20 million for a corporation, or a fine of up to RM10 million, imprisonment for up to 10 years, or both, for an individual

stories.headline: China's CXMT to start HBM3E production despite 20-30% yields, sources say

key_facts.fact: CXMT, China's largest DRAM maker, plans to start HBM3E production even though as little as 20% of the chips it makes are usable, two sources told Reuters.
key_facts.excerpt: China's CXMT plans to start production of HBM3E... despite as little as 20% of the chips it makes being usable, two people familiar with the matter said.

key_facts.fact: CXMT yields are about 20% to 30%, versus around 70% at SK Hynix; limited production is expected within the next two months.
key_facts.excerpt: Yields... are only about 20% to 30%, compared with yields of around 70% at South Korea's SK Hynix... It expects to begin limited production over the next two months

key_facts.fact: In testing, CXMT's HBM3E performed closer to SK Hynix's previous-generation HBM3; CXMT sent samples to several domestic AI chip designers in two versions.
key_facts.excerpt: In testing, CXMT's HBM3E performance was closer to SK Hynix's previous-generation HBM3 than to the South Korean company's HBM3E... CXMT has sent customers two HBM3E versions

key_facts.fact: The push reflects China's AI memory shortage under US curbs; Huawei, Cambricon, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX raised AI chip prices 20% to 50% last month as memory costs rose.
key_facts.excerpt: Reuters reported last month that Huawei, Cambricon, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX had raised prices for current and next-generation AI chips by 20% to 50% as memory costs complicated efforts to ramp up production.

key_facts.fact: The US tightened export controls on certain HBM products bound for China in December 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: In Dec. 2024, the United States tightened export controls on certain HBM products bound for China

stories.headline: TPG in talks to buy UK operator Ark Data Centres from Elliott at about $5 billion

key_facts.fact: TPG is in talks to acquire UK-based Ark Data Centres from Elliott Management at a valuation of about $5 billion, the Financial Times reported on Oct. 28; a deal is not guaranteed.
key_facts.excerpt: TPG is in talks to acquire UK group Ark Data Centres from Elliott Management at a valuation of about $5bn, in what would be one of the sector's biggest deals of the year.

key_facts.fact: Ark, based in Wiltshire, operates 27 data centres across the UK and Belgium.
key_facts.excerpt: Ark Data Centres, based in Wiltshire, England, operates 27 facilities across the UK and Belgium.

key_facts.fact: Ark runs Crown Hosting Data Centres, a joint venture with the UK Cabinet Office giving it access to all UK public-sector data centre requirements; Elliott acquired Ark in 2012.
key_facts.excerpt: Ark has a joint venture with the UK Government's Cabinet Office, called Crown Hosting Data Centres, which gives it access to all UK public data centre requirements. Elliott, which had acquired Ark Data Centres in 2012

key_facts.fact: At that valuation the deal would rank among the five largest data centre acquisitions this year; global data centre deals have reached $89.4 billion in 2026, 50% above all of 2025 (Synergy Research Group).
key_facts.excerpt: A transaction at the proposed valuation would rank among the five largest global data centre acquisitions this year, according to Synergy Research Group. Global data centre deal activity has reached $89.4bn in 2026, already exceeding the total recorded in 2025 by 50%

key_facts.fact: TPG entered data centres in 2019 and has invested in cloud infrastructure provider Crusoe.
key_facts.excerpt: TPG has expanded rapidly into digital infrastructure through its real estate investment platform, entering the data centre sector in 2019... including investments in cloud infrastructure provider Crusoe.

stories.headline: Chinese GPU maker Moore Threads posts Q3 revenue up 1,774% and swings to a profit

key_facts.fact: Moore Threads reported Q3 2026 revenue of RMB 1.552 billion, up 1,773.92% year on year, in its unaudited report dated Oct. 28.
key_facts.excerpt: reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of 1,552,307,664.26 yuan (RMB), up 1,773.92% from a year earlier... according to the company's unaudited third-quarter report dated October 28, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Q3 net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 49.26 million (about $7.4 million), swinging from a loss.
key_facts.excerpt: net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 49,260,412.76, swinging from a loss

key_facts.fact: Nine-month revenue was RMB 3.289 billion, up 319% year on year.
key_facts.excerpt: 9M revenue was RMB 3.289bn, up 319.15% YoY, as AI compute demand drove accelerated deployments.

key_facts.fact: The company credited demand for its MTT S5000 chips from cloud providers, token service providers, AI startups, telecom operators and government customers.
key_facts.excerpt: intelligent-computing products represented by the MTT S5000 won a high degree of customer recognition and that business accelerated across internet and cloud service providers (CSPs), token service providers (TSPs), AI innovation companies, operators...

key_facts.fact: Q3 R&D spending rose 87.89% to RMB 571 million, tied to its next-generation HuaGang GPU architecture.
key_facts.excerpt: Third-quarter research and development investment was RMB 571,110,565.82, up 87.89%... The report ties the increase to faster progress on products built around the company's next-generation "HuaGang" full-function GPU architecture.

key_facts.fact: JD Cloud announced in September it plans a 100,000-GPU cluster built on Moore Threads GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: On September 9, 2026, JD Cloud announced... that it plans to build a 100,000-GPU full-function cluster using Moore Threads GPUs as the computing foundation
